name: Sergio Drucci
source:
Sergio does all he can to build up a persona of a tough, hard man, but he fails miserably in the face of someone he possibly likes. Although he has been burned in the past, he is surprisingly open and vulnerable, willing to trust most people. Sergio gives the MC (and others) the benefit of the doubt, perhaps stupidly.

Sergio would like to pretend that he is a private person, but the truth is that he runs his mouth and is very bad at censoring his thoughts. He’s an open book to most people. Some may wonder how he rose to his position as the leader of the mafia, and it has to do with his charisma and previous relationship with Lucien. Lucien assisted Sergio in rising to power, hence the increased bitterness about their parting.

[From strategy guide]
